description:
Intent i003 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=xmit-softirq-lock) complete. One finding reported, artifact at agent-state/findings/i003.json.

FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1991-1996, quote 'spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock);' (lock declared :209, init :6150). UNTRUSTED SOURCE: attacker-influenced concurrency triggers — any QoS data frame driving mac80211 .tx (mwl8k_tx at :4691) into mwl8k_txq_xmit (def :1898, call :4705) under NET_TX softirq, plus hardirq-scheduled watchdog worker on the same CPU. VIOLATED INVARIANT: stream_lock is shared between softirq-reachable xmit code and process/workqueue code but all 16 acquisitions (1992, 2056, 2079, 2129, 3835, 3848, 4165, 4176, 5461, 5502, 5523, 5541, 5552, 5559) use plain spin_lock — no spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable anywhere for this lock, while the same function takes the sibling tx_lock with spin_lock_bh at :2064 (also 1578/1591/1597), proving the xmit path runs with BH enabled. PROCESS/WORKQUEUE HOLDERS: mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events worker (:3818, INIT_WORK :6127, queued from hardirq mwl8k_interrupt via ieee80211_queue_work :4620) takes the plain lock at :3835; mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (:4157, lock :4165) from mwl8k_sta_remove (:5331) in cfg80211 process context; mwl8k_ampdu_action (lock :5461+) from cfg80211 process context. UNSAFE USE: worker/user task holding stream_lock while NET_TX softirq on the same CPU runs mwl8k_txq_xmit spins forever on the lock the preempted holder can never release -> soft lockup, RCU stall, device TX stall DoS, the exact seed mechanism. COUNTEREVIDENCE: no _bh/irqsave variant for stream_lock in the file; mac80211 may also call .tx in process context which narrows but does not close the softirq window (hence medium confidence).

Candidates classified: wwan_hwsim.c:202 safe (all 12 plain locks in debugfs/netlink/module process-context paths, no xmit/NAPI/tasklet pairing); qtnfmac/trans.c:30 unresolved (resp_lock softirq reachability untraced); cassini.c, cxgb4/sge.c, hostap_ap.c unresolved (density-ranked only). Negative/limits: search bounded to s02; no runtime reproducer (no .config/headers); enumeration traced deeply only mwl8k and wwan_hwsim; ks7010 seed never reported.
